endorsements.name: Niraj Mahajan
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-47948
endorsements.description: WordPress GetPaid Plugin 2.4.6 contains an HTML injection vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to inject arbitrary HTML code by exploiting the Help Text field in payment forms. Attackers can inject malicious HTML including image tags and scripts into the Help Text field during payment form creation, which gets stored in the database and executed in the browser when the form is viewed.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.4)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.
